title: utilz liberator still asks the retired utilz use, so doctor fails
objective: Utilz retired `utilz use`, which now says "utilz use is retired: run 'bin/devbin use' in a Utilz checkout". Molt's utilz liberator still asks `utilz use` which tree serves utilz (`liberators/utilz.sh`, its check), so the check fails, and `molt doctor` reads 16 of 17 on kovacs (kovacs-sysadm, 27 Nov). Read the tree from `utilz --version`, whose line names it (devbin contract T4), and change the hints that name `utilz use brew` to `bin/devbin use`.
